title: Clean up formatting in owned-directory test fixtures
outcome: Remove trailing whitespace on the seven new evaluator fixture let-bindings and wrap the two readiness-cache initializers consistently, without changing fixture behavior.
acceptance: The seven evaluator let-binding lines have no trailing whitespace, and the readiness-cache initializers in tests/mod.rs and tests/persist.rs use the same wrapped style as tests/session_settings.rs.
The cleanup preserves directory ownership, request values and all assertions.
